payload.question: Did the council spend what it planned on day-to-day services?
payload.label: Day-to-day spending against budget, 2021/22
payload.council_caveat: The council states this as 2.18% of its gross expenditure budget. That year the figure it divides by is about £109m; from 2022/23 it uses a gross General Fund figure of about £65m. The council changed the basis, so this percentage is not directly comparable with the ones below it.
payload.evidence: The council set a budget for 2021/22 and its own accounts say it came in 2.18% under — £2.384m less than planned. Both numbers are in the narrative report at the front of that year's Statement of Accounts.
